title: Deliver the checked-in master and verify worker access
text: Deliver one maintained source in checked-in Yoke internal docs. Verify both projects’ worker access; Yoke items update the source and Platform items file linked Yoke updates. Install upkeep only in blocking post-deploy QA.
detail: The draft is local; relay iCloud access failed in operator evidence. YOK-3914 and PLAT-220 must deliver one checked-in Yoke source, verify both projects’ actual access, and install upkeep only in post-deploy QA.
